_readme: Government circulars often give no place: it is only inside the PDF advertisement, which the robot cannot read.
When an organisation works from one place, write it here and its posts get that place.
Left side: part of the organisation's name, as it appears on the post (capital and small letters do not matter).
Right side: a district in English as the site spells it (Dhaka, Chattogram, Khulna, Bogura, ...), or 'Area, District' (Agargaon, Dhaka).
Do not add an organisation that hires for offices all over the country (Bangladesh Post Office, Bangladesh Police, the banks): leave those without a place.
The robot never guesses a place. An organisation whose own name says the place (Ashuganj Power Station, Dhaka WASA) is found without this file.
